headline: Meta is letting go of employees it hired in June from the AI safety startup Virtue AI, only four months after they joined.
score_reason: Pool score 5; fact check suggests 3: older news; Semafor broke the story on 2 Oct and we carried it on 3 Oct, and the 5 Oct version adds only an unsupported co-founder claim.
importance_line: It affects the employees Meta hired from Virtue AI, and Meta says its AI safety work continues, but nothing new has been verified since 2 Oct, the number of people affected is not given, and the claim that the three co-founders are among them is Moneycontrol's alone.
summary: Semafor reported on 2 Oct 2026, and Moneycontrol repeated on 5 Oct, that Meta is letting go of employees it hired in June from Virtue AI, an AI security startup, with Meta spokesperson Andy Stone saying 'the arrangement didn't work out as planned' because of clashing work styles and that Meta Superintelligence Labs remains focused on AI safety research. This is the story we carried on 3 Oct 2026; Moneycontrol adds that Virtue AI co-founders Bo Li, Dawn Song and Sanmi Koyejo are among those leaving, but Semafor's original does not say so and names them only as having joined Meta in June.
notes: Re-run of a story we carried on 3 Oct 2026 (item 19, Semafor); the first reporter is Semafor, whose original was read, so the url is Semafor's. Likely held back as re-dated old news. Moneycontrol's co-founder claim is not in Semafor's report.
